title: Dinosaur Trundle Day Bed w TV
description:
Locked bedroom has a daybed with a twin trundle. There is a TV in the bedroom. Great location in Hendersonville with access to kitchen, living room, dining room, laundry room, outdoor area including hot tub and fire pit. Close to marina, restaurants, greenways and less than 25 minute drive to downtown Nashville and Opryland.

Guest access
Guests have access to all parts of the house except for the other bedrooms.

Other things to note
There is absolutely no smoking on my property.  Any evidence of smoking will incur a $250 fee.
